subject: reasoning
question:
Raj visited a city on an even day before both Meenu and Kavya.

If Meenu went on the 18th and Kavya on the 20th, then when did Raj go?
solution:
**Given:**

 
• Raj visited on an even numbered day.
 
• Raj went before both Meenu and Kavya.
 
• Meenu went on the 18th.
 
• Kavya went on the 20th.

⇒ Raj must have visited before both 18th and 20th, meaning Raj visited before the 18th.
